verses.text: Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.
From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

segments.text: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed:
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.text: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.

segments.text: For thou hast been a refuge for me,
A strong tower from the enemy.

verses.text: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. [Selah

segments.text: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever:
I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. [Selah

verses.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

segments.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows:
the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life; His years shall be as many generations.

segments.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life;
His years shall be as many generations.

verses.text: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

segments.text: He shall abide before God for ever:
Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

verses.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.

segments.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever,
That I may daily perform my vows.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. A Psalm of David.
